description: Checks every record in the project's .signafaide/ folder (or a verification pack): schema, hashes, agent signatures, chain links and content hashes, and, for records a witness has co-signed, Merkle proofs, the service's batch and head signatures, drand and anchors. With an API key it first ships waiting records (signafaide_flush is the explicit way to ship them without verifying); without one nothing is sent. Returns one line per check, what still needs the witness, and PASS or FAIL. To list the records themselves, use signafaide_records.

directory.description: Path of the project to work on: the folder the MCP server was started in, or one below it. Default: that folder.

pack.description: Path of a pack from `signafaide export`, instead of the local state.

name: signafaide_verify
title: Verify the local signafAIde records
